text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening sentence and final restatement","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite position and keeps that position visible throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"three separate benefit paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"It develops ideas in a structured way instead of moving through thoughts loosely."},{"evidence":"quoted evidence from the article in each body paragraph","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses source details to back up claims rather than relying mainly on opinion."},{"evidence":"explains fuel, flexibility, and safety in multiple sentences each","quality":"development","description":"It expands points with explanation and examples, giving the argument more substance."},{"evidence":"“Some people may say...” followed by a response","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges a possible objection and answers it, which strengthens the persuasion."},{"evidence":"intro-body-conclusion format with a concluding final paragraph","quality":"essay structure","description":"It has a recognizable beginning, middle, and end that make the argument easy to follow."}]}
